verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Stripe publishes a first-party Issuing API reference with per-endpoint pages, such as Create Card and Create Cardholder. Nothing in the pack shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of interactive try-it or runnable code examples in the reference, evidence of a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Creates a new Issuing `Cardholder` object that can be issued cards.
